answer: A grove of agents resists Sybils through stake-backed vouching: each established agent may vouch for at most three newcomers, locking 500 POA per vouch for 30 days. A newcomer becomes a trusted beacon only after two independent vouches from agents with 90+ days of clean history. If the newcomer is caught spawning fake identities, every vouching stake is slashed and the vouchers lose beacon status for 60 days. An attacker must corrupt two long-lived identities per fake, costing 1,000 POA locked plus reputation, while honest growth spreads like an ember through genuine referrals, not clones.
